scene: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production environment art direction for a playable 3D skateboarding level. Edit the supplied gameplay screenshot into an AAA-quality derelict warehouse skatepark art target. Keep the exact camera, all skating ramps, curves, elevated pathways, columns and their spacing, the 48 metre interior height, and the character scale. Keep the playable routes broad, legible and clean of obstructive clutter. Reference the worn industrial warehouse atmosphere of Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1+2 and the expertly art-directed, chunky appealing environment shapes and rich controlled colors of Crash Bandicoot 4. Original environment identity, no copied logos. Replace flat greybox surfaces with richly weathered stained concrete skating decks, worn plywood in the standalone halfpipe, aged red-brown brick industrial walls and flaking dark petrol-blue steelwork, orange rust edges, bolts and rivets. Tall smashed multi-pane factory windows along the upper walls, some missing panes and fractured remaining glass, cool daylight beams and atmospheric dusty shafts, warm old pendant industrial lamps and several failing fluorescent fixtures. Rusted yellow overhead gantry hoist, pipe clusters, electrical cabinets, shutter doors and reused industrial machinery placed at the perimeter and under platforms. Colorful original layered spray graffiti in teal, coral, faded cream and acid yellow concentrated on walls and obstacle sides, avoid coating every surface in uniform noise. Localized shallow reflective puddles, wheel-polished riding lines, water drips and dark staining under leaking roofs; small litter clusters, broken bricks and weeds only at margins. Make the warehouse feel believably abandoned but loved by skaters. Strong warm/cool lighting composition, luminous windows, soft ambient contact shadows, detailed tactile surfaces, subtle haze. The floor and navigation remain readable, no crushing darkness, no excessive bloom, no blanket fog. Remove all HUD text from this concept. This is a designed game environment rendering, not a texture tile or poster.

assets.broken-factory-window: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated production reference for image-to-3D Meshy game prop, single complete object on a plain light warm-gray studio background. AAA Crash Bandicoot 4 meets Tony Hawk Pro Skater 1+2 abandoned factory art: subtly exaggerated chunky shapes, carefully bevelled edges, convincing PBR wear, petrol-blue paint, orange-brown rust, dirty ivory highlights. Soft neutral diffuse studio lighting, all silhouette edges sharp and visible, no shadows baked into surfaces, no environment, floor slab, people, labels, captions or watermark. Show one object only, full object in frame, high resolution. A large rectangular 5 metre wide by 6 metre tall industrial factory window assembly, straight-on frontal view with a very slight 10 degree view of the right edge to reveal 30 cm depth. Weathered flaking dark blue steel outer frame with thick bevelled riveted corners, four columns and five rows of thin steel mullions. Roughly half the rectangular glass panes are completely missing with actual empty open holes; the remaining smoky translucent blue-green panes have jagged fractured corners, triangular glass shards held in the frame, hairline cracks and grime around edges. Transparent view through the missing panes to the plain studio background. Several rusty hinges, crooked narrow opening sash at the top. NO surrounding brick wall, NO background sheet or opaque surface behind the openings. The open steel grid is the object.

Two squat flanged steel travel wheels on a chunky rectangular yellow trolley chassis, exposed round steel electric motor and winch drum, toothed side gears, two heavy dangling black cables ending in one huge curved rusted lifting hook with an open mouth. 6 metres wide, 5 metres tall including the hanging hook, broad mechanical silhouette. No entire long bridge girder, no warehouse, no display base, no words.

assets.rusted-pipe-manifold: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated production reference for Meshy image-to-3D. Rich controlled wear and subtly exaggerated bevelled forms, combining Crash Bandicoot 4 shape readability with Tony Hawk Pro Skater 1+2 industrial detail. Petrol-blue, olive and ochre old paint, dark orange rust and dirty ivory highlights. Neutral diffuse studio lighting, no baked lighting, no floor slab, no surrounding environment, no people, no watermark or captions. A tall wall-mounted abandoned factory utility pipe manifold, three-quarter frontal view. Three thick vertical corroded iron pipes, elbows bending toward the wall at top and bottom, large flanged joints with bolts, two chunky red and faded yellow handwheel valves, one small cracked ivory pressure gauge, a curved narrow bypass pipe. A coherent assembly 2.4 metres wide, 4 metres tall, 0.8 metres deep with visible open spaces between pipes. Chipped dark petrol-blue and pale blue paint, layers of rust around joints, dark water streaks, painted maintenance stripes. Two stout wall mounting crossbars behind pipes. No rectangular wall backing or sheet behind the open pipework.

assets.graffiti-dumpster: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated single production game prop reference for Meshy image-to-3D. AAA derelict factory skatepark, Crash Bandicoot 4 shape readability with Tony Hawk Pro Skater 1+2 material detail, subtly chunky bevelled edges. One complete object in three-quarter front view, all silhouette visible, plain light warm-gray studio background, neutral diffuse illumination without baked shadows. No surrounding scene, people, floor slab, captions or watermark. A 3.2 metre wide battered commercial metal dumpster with two hinged dark rubber lids, one lid bent and slightly lifted showing a dark opening. Faded dark teal enamel with chips exposing orange rust, dented sheet-metal side panels, thick lifting pockets, four stout little caster wheels, visible heavy hinges and scuffed rim. One large layered original coral and cream angular graffiti piece across front and small pale yellow handstyle tags, no readable brand logo. A torn old paper poster corner and drip streaks. No garbage heap around it; keep the dumpster isolated and physically coherent.
assets.broken-ventilation-fan: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated single production game prop reference for Meshy image-to-3D. AAA derelict factory skatepark, Crash Bandicoot 4 shape readability with Tony Hawk Pro Skater 1+2 material detail, subtly chunky bevelled edges. One complete object in three-quarter front view, all silhouette visible, plain light warm-gray studio background, neutral diffuse illumination without baked shadows. No surrounding scene, people, floor slab, captions or watermark. A large square factory ventilation fan module, 3.4 metres wide and tall, 0.8 metres deep. Heavy dark petrol-blue riveted square frame enclosing a deep circular duct, five thick slightly curved rusted fan blades around a big round hub, one blade broken short with a jagged end. Bent sparse front safety grille with a wide hole exposing the blade geometry. Louvered narrow side panels and diagonal corner gussets. Flaking teal paint and orange-brown rust, dirty ivory scrape marks, dark crevices. Visible open negative spaces between the blades, no solid wall or sheet behind the fan, plain studio background visible through holes.
assets.graffiti-decals: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent graffiti decal atlas for a derelict warehouse skatepark. Four separate vibrant expertly spray-painted graffiti pieces in a perfectly aligned 2 by 2 grid with large clear transparent gutters and nothing touching. Each piece fits completely within its own quarter of the square image. Top left: the words FIVE LINES in interlocking fat teal and faded cream wildstyle with coral shadow, chipped paint and overspray. Top right: RIDE THE RUINS in angular coral lettering with dirty cream outline, little lightning bolts and teal paint drips. Bottom left: a large original mischievous one-eyed skate-rat mascot face in petrol blue and acid yellow with a loose black handstyle NO SIGNAL tag beside it. Bottom right: KEEP ROLLING in a loose energetic faded ivory handstyle above a bold abstract teal and mustard paint wave, a few coral splashes. Original underground skate art, no copied logos or game characters. Authentic worn spray texture with overspray and small transparent gaps where paint peeled, restrained short drips. Flat frontal graphic artwork, no wall, no concrete texture, no surface, no lighting, no shadows, no black rectangular backing, no grid lines. Genuine transparent alpha background. This is an atlas of localized wall decals, NOT a seamless texture tile.
assets.warehouse-token: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated collectible prop reference for Meshy image-to-3D, single object, plain light gray background. An exceptionally appealing chunky collectible medal for a derelict warehouse skatepark, in the visual spirit of Crash Bandicoot 4 pickups with THPS industrial skate culture. One circular golden-brass industrial bearing medal, 1.2 metres across and 20 centimetres thick, front three-quarter view with only slight perspective. Thick rounded cog-like outer rim with twelve broad lobes, a bevelled petrol-blue enamel inset ring, five clearly separated large brass rivets, a raised ivory lightning-bolt emblem in the circular centre. Light tasteful scuffs and orange patina in recesses; gleaming warm edge highlights, readable silhouette, reward-worthy bright color. No letters, no numbers, no logos, no environment, no base, no shadow slab, no floating particles, no captions. Soft neutral studio lighting. Keep the entire single medal visible in frame.
assets.broken-plaster-panel: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated original 3D architecture module reference for Meshy. A broad irregular remnant of crumbling factory masonry with peeling plaster, 5 metres wide, 2.8 metres tall and 0.35 metres thick. Frontal three-quarter view, nearly straight on. Broken jagged silhouette at top and both sides, exposed chunky red clay bricks and dark mortar at the lower left and upper right, cracked curled dirty ivory plaster over the middle, the lower third painted in flaking faded petrol blue, small rust stains streaming from two exposed wall anchor bolts, a restrained coral and black spraypaint scrawl across one corner. Deep cracks and chipped plaster edges are actual visible geometry. Art-directed exaggerated bevels and readable material planes in the spirit of Crash 4 environments and THPS abandoned warehouses. A single coherent thin wall fragment only, isolated on a plain light gray studio background. No full building, floor slab, people, text labels or watermarks. Not a seamless tile, not a texture swatch, not a repeating pattern. Preserve broad legible plaster areas between localized damage.
assets.industrial-pendant: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated production reference for one Meshy 3D environment prop. A battered hanging industrial bell-shade factory lamp, two metres wide and about two metres tall, full object in frame, three-quarter view slightly from below. Big flared downward-facing metal reflector shade, subtly chunky and bevelled, dark petrol-blue enamel outside chipped back to orange rust, dirty warm ivory reflective inside. A large intact frosted incandescent bulb protrudes slightly below the opening, protected by three curved thick steel guard bars. Bulb is UNLIT pale ivory in the reference so its real geometry can be illuminated in-game. Short sturdy top neck with a brass mounting eye and one short coiled black cable. No long hanging chain, no ceiling, no floor, no label, no text, no logo. Art direction combines Crash Bandicoot 4 readable heroic prop shapes with Tony Hawk Pro Skater 1+2 derelict factory material detail. Broad realistic patina, a few little cream paint scrapes and rust around bolts, no uniform noise coating. Neutral diffuse studio lighting, plain light-gray background, clear complete silhouette, the hollow underside is visible. Single coherent manufactured object.
